title: Form 1095-A (Health Insurance Marketplace Statement), Part III
description: The form's own grid, lines 21-32, columns A (enrollment premiums), B (the applicable SLCSP premium) and C (advance payment of the premium tax credit), one cents field per cell; line 33's totals are derived. A month is a coverage month when its column A is above zero; the policy's dates are the first and last coverage months. One form per return at the pin (a second is refused by name). A form with no coverage month, column C in a month without column A, or a zero column B on a coverage month is refused by name. Reaches Form 8962 and, through Schedule 2 line 2 or Schedule 3 line 9, Form 1040 lines 24, 33 and 34.

jan_slcsp_cents.description: Form 1095-A line 21 (January), column B — monthly second lowest cost silver plan (SLCSP) premium. Optional: blank or 0 is a month without coverage.

jan_aptc_cents.description: Form 1095-A line 21 (January), column C — monthly advance payment of premium tax credit. Optional: blank or 0 is a month without coverage.
